title: Rey risks his mask against Eddie Guerrero
summary: Eddie Guerrero targets the symbol of Rey Mysterio’s identity while holding the Cruiserweight championship. Rey must risk his mask to turn humiliation into a title opportunity.

chapters.title: Eddie tears away Rey’s mask
chapters.context: The attack gives their title rivalry personal stakes rooted in Rey’s lucha libre identity.

chapters.title: Rey saves his mask and wins the title
chapters.result: Mysterio defeats Guerrero in the title-versus-mask match.
chapters.context: The challenger survives Eddie’s attacks and leaves with both his identity intact and the championship.

chapters.title: Eddie takes the title back
chapters.result: Guerrero defeats Mysterio to regain the Cruiserweight championship.
chapters.context: The reversal continues their competitive rivalry after the major mask-match payoff.
